description: Correct the unit cost of stock that is already on hand, without moving any units: for stock that came in without a receipt (a direct add with adjust_stock, a stock-level set, an import) at the wrong cost. Re-values that stock to the cost it should have come in at; units already sold or removed from it are re-valued too, on the account they left through. A connected ledger gets one correction journal set against Inventory Adjustment. Does not change the item's catalog cost (upsert_items does that, and it only values stock that came in at $0). Stock received on a purchase order's delivery receipt is refused: correct its cost on that receipt in the app. Each call re-values one cost layer of one item; when the item has more than one eligible layer, the refusal lists them and costLayerId picks one. Two-step: preview=true, then repeat the identical call with the previewReceipt and a fresh idempotencyKey. Requires Write + inventory.execute.

costLayerId.description: Optional: the cost layer (GUID) to re-value, when the item holds more than one eligible layer. Omit it when the item has exactly one.

idempotencyKey.description: Caller-generated idempotency key; required with previewReceipt to commit.

item.description: Item id (GUID) or SKU whose stock to re-value.

preview.description: Step 1 of the required two-step write: set true to validate and receive a structured preview plus a single-use previewReceipt. Nothing changes until the commit call.

previewReceipt.description: Step 2 of the required two-step write: the receipt returned by the preview call. Supply together with a fresh idempotencyKey to commit; calls without it are refused.

reason.description: Why the cost is being corrected (e.g. "Landed cost corrected from supplier invoice"), up to 500 characters. Kept on the correction record.

unitCost.description: The unit cost the stock should carry, in the account's currency (e.g. 0.2427). Must differ from the cost it carries now.

name: revalue_stock_cost
title: Revalue Stock Cost
